newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 28.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 28.

text.p: Mexican port Veracruz was reported closed Friday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
The port was shut because of dense fog. Neighboring Coatzacoalcos was shut to smaller ships, but shipping petroleum regularly from its Pajaritos port, an official told Reuters.
Nautla, Puerto Juarez and Rosarito ports were closed to smaller tourism and fishing boats, the ministry said.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Weak cold front headed southeast at velocity of 18 knots (34 km/20 miles per hour) possibly carrying rains and lower temperatures to coast of Baja California. Winds from 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) and waves five to seven feet high.
Lower temperatures and clouds along coast of Tamaulipas state, with winds mostly from east and southeast from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour).
Hot and partly cloudy with isolated showers, moderate east and southeast winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
